title: Getting started with frmtmb
text: car() fits conditional autoregressive field adjacency matrix, brms’s spelling four types. M symmetric binary adjacency matrix whose dimnames name locations, gr grouping variable maps observations onto , type one "escar" (proper CAR, default), "icar" alias "esicar" (intrinsic), "bym2" (scaled mixture spatial unstructured part). sd(car) field scale; escar bym2 add mixing parameter (0, 1), reported confint_varcorr() brms’s names car rhocar. intrinsic CAR improper - field identified constant per connected component - icar, esicar bym2 add brms’s soft sum--zero constraint, whose scale con_sd (brms’s 1e-3 default, relative field’s sd). Tightening walks fit onto exactly constrained likelihood; default already four orders standard error sd(car). spde() fits Matern field finite-element mesh: takes mesh’s three matrices (fmesher::fm_fem()’s c0/g1/g2, INLA’s M0/M1/M2) fixed data estimates Q = tau^2 (kappa^4 M0 + 2 kappa^2 M1 + M2). Mesh construction stays outside package; gr maps observations onto mesh nodes. confint_varcorr() reports marginal sd range planar alpha = 2 identities.
code: set.seed(4) grid <- expand.grid(r = 1:5, c = 1:5) nloc <- nrow(grid) W <- matrix(0, nloc, nloc) for (i in seq_len(nloc)) {   for (j in seq_len(nloc)) {     if (abs(grid$r[i] - grid$r[j]) + abs(grid$c[i] - grid$c[j]) == 1) {       W[i, j] <- 1     }   } } dimnames(W) <- list(paste0("L", 1:nloc), paste0("L", 1:nloc)) phi <- 0.7 * as.numeric(scale(grid$r + grid$c)) + 0.7 * rnorm(nloc) dc <- data.frame(loc = factor(rep(rownames(W), each = 8),                               levels = rownames(W))) dc$y <- 1 + phi[as.integer(dc$loc)] + rnorm(nrow(dc), 0, 0.5) fc <- frm(bf(y ~ car(W, gr = loc, type = "escar")) + gaussian(),           data = dc) confint_varcorr(fc) #>                              block    term type estimate       lwr       upr #> 1 car(W, gr = loc, type = "escar") sd(car)   sd 1.111466 0.8096418 1.5258056 #> 2 car(W, gr = loc, type = "escar")     car prop 0.951133 0.5172424 0.9971797

text: bf() brms spelling; families attach +. Ports brms code drop priors change brm() frm(). Distributional regression: every distributional parameter takes formula full predictor grammar (bf(y ~ s(x) + (1 | g), sigma ~ s(z) + (1 | g))), constant. Random effects: lme4 syntax plus structured covariances - us, diag, homdiag, cs, homcs, ar1, hetar1, toep, homtoep, ou, spatial exp/gau/mat num_factor(x, y) coordinates, reduced-rank rr(d =), known structure gr(g, cov = ) / gr(g, prec = Q) / equalto(), |ID| correlation across formulas. Spatial Gaussian Markov random fields: car(M, gr = g, type =) brms’s spelling four types (escar, esicar, icar, bym2, last brms’s scaling convention), spde(fem, gr = node) Matern field finite-element mesh (fmesher/INLA matrices fixed data). Precisions assembled tape fixed sparse matrices every normalizing constant analytic. mgcv smooths s()/t2() linear predictor, including matrix-covariate terms: scalar--function, function--scalar, function--function regression. Gaussian processes: gp(x) exact kriging prediction, gp(x, k = 30) Hilbert-space (brms’s exact input convention, call approximation), three dimensions (gp(x1, x2), per-dimension lengthscales, iso = TRUE share). Special terms: mo() monotonic effects, mi() one-step imputation continuous predictors, mi(sdx) measurement error, cs() category-specific ordinal effects; mo()/mi() support two-way interactions. Multivariate models (mvbf, per-response families, rescor), nonlinear formulas (nl = TRUE), matrix-response multinomial(K). Families: usual GLM(M) set plus student, tweedie, compois, beta-binomial, skew-normal, ex-gaussian, weibull, shifted lognormal, quantile regression (asym_laplace), zero-inflated hurdle variants, four ordinal families, finite mixture() families - including group-level latent classes (mixture(..., groups = ~g)) class-specific random effects (growth-mixture models) multivariate gaussian components (mixture_mvn(K, D, model =), model-based clustering mclust’s covariance taxonomy, covariate-dependent means gating). custom_family() takes plain R log-density (test suite fits Wiener drift-diffusion model 15 lines). title: Pooled model comparison across imputations (D1, D2, D3) — anova.frmtmb_multiple
text: "D1" Multivariate Wald (Li, Raghunathan Rubin 1991). Let Qbar pooled estimate k coefficients larger model adds, Ubar average within-imputation covariance B -imputation covariance. average relative increase variance r, (1 + 1/m) tr(B Ubar^-1) / k, statistic Qbar' ((1 + r) Ubar)^-1 Qbar / k k v degrees freedom. v uses Reiter (2007) small-sample form dfcom finite Li et al form otherwise. "D2" Pooled test statistics (Li, Meng, Raghunathan Rubin 1991). m per-imputation statistics d - either likelihood-ratio chi-squares (use = "likelihood") Wald chi-squares (use = "wald") - r set (1 + 1/m) var(sqrt(d)), statistic (mean(d)/k - (m + 1)/(m - 1) r) / (1 + r) k k^(-3/m) (m - 1) (1 + 1/r)^2 degrees freedom. D2 needs covariance matrix, cheapest rule least efficient. "D3" Pooled likelihood ratio (Meng Rubin 1992). average deviance difference computed twice: imputation-specific estimates (dbar) pooled estimates (dtilde), second evaluating imputation's likelihood one common parameter vector. r set (m + 1) / (k (m - 1)) (dbar - dtilde), statistic dtilde / (k (1 + r)). D3 default: needs covariance matrix either, unlike D2 stays valid coefficients far normal. Pooled parameter values plain across-imputation means optimizer's parameter vector, variance components pooled internal (log / Cholesky) scale, matching $pooled. model refit: imputation's objective re-evaluated pooled vector, costs one Laplace solve. mice::D3() instead fixes pooled coefficients offset re-estimates every remaining parameter, can differ percent; mitml::testModels(method = "D3") uses plug-form implemented . Note also df.residual() counts dispersion parameter gaussian fit, lm() , dfcom one smaller mice's default; pass dfcom explicitly reproduce mice exactly.

code: build_objective <- function(frame) {   lps       <- frame$linpreds   blocks    <- frame$re_blocks   block_nll <- lapply(blocks, \(bk) covstruct_registry[[bk$covstruct]]$nll)   fam_lpdf  <- lapply(frame$spec$responses, \(r) r$family$lpdf)   y         <- frame$y    function(pars) {     RTMB::getAll(pars, warn = FALSE)     "[<-" <- RTMB::ADoverload("[<-")     nll <- 0     for (bk in blocks)                       # loop over structure, not obs       nll <- nll - block_nll[[...]](b[bk$b_idx], theta[bk$theta_idx], bk$aux)     dparv <- list()     for (lp in lps) {       eta <- drop(lp$X %*% beta[lp$beta_idx])       if (!is.null(lp$Z))      eta <- eta + drop(lp$Z %*% b[lp$b_idx])       if (!is.null(lp$offset)) eta <- eta + lp$offset       dparv[[lp$key]] <- lp$link$inv(eta)     }     for (r in names(y)) {       yobs <- RTMB::OBS(y[[r]])              # free simulate() and OSA       nll  <- nll - sum(w[[r]] * fam_lpdf[[r]](yobs, dpars_for(r, dparv),                                                frame$spec$responses[[r]]$aterms))     }     nll   } }
